summary: Year-end rally review: Nifty up 3,000 pts in 11 weeks (10,800→13,800); FIIs buying ~₹2,500 cr/day (Nov >₹65k cr, Dec ~₹35k cr); Fed lifts bank buyback ban; Accenture fuels IT; Reliance gas find. Range call 13,400–14,000; sell 14,100/14,200 calls, 13,200 puts.

events.claim: US Fed lifted pandemic-era restrictions on bank share buybacks after close on 18 Dec 2020; US bank stocks rose 4–6% after hours
FIIs bought over ₹65,000 crore in November 2020 and ~₹35,000 crore in December-to-date (~₹1.1 lakh crore over seven weeks)
Nifty rose from ~10,800 to 13,800 in 11 weeks; weekly futures high exactly 13,799 on 18 Dec 2020
Reliance announced a KG-basin gas find/start-up said to meet ~15% of India's gas demand (news just before close, 18 Dec 2020)

lessons: Above 100-point intraday falls are buying opportunities in a strong uptrend — sell puts into them.
Less volume near year-end can induce volatility; thin price action is unreliable.
quote: If there is an intraday fall of more than 100 points in Nifty, that is a buying opportunity.

summary: COVID-strain Monday: Nifty >500 intraday fall, Bank Nifty −1,500, then three-day rebound; week closed near prior close. Year-end: FII volumes −30–40%, holiday lull. OI: 13,500 PE / 14,000 CE max. Brexit deal done. Range call 13,500–14,000; sold calls >14,000, puts <13,500.

events.claim: On Monday 21 Dec 2020 Nifty fell more than 500 points intraday and Bank Nifty ~1,500 points on the new UK COVID-strain scare, then recovered over three sessions
UK–EU Brexit trade deal agreed over the Christmas weekend (24 Dec 2020), removing long-standing uncertainty
Kotak Mahindra Bank and several IT stocks hit all-time/52-week highs that week; FII volumes down 30–40% into year-end

lessons: Bull-market corrections are fast and furious — and can recover with the same speed.
Holiday-week volume is insignificant, so price action in it should also be treated as insignificant.
quote: Fruit-bearing trees only receive the stones.
leaks: ASR: 'AllowStreetWeekAhead' = Dalal Street Week Ahead; 'Quartag bank' = Kotak Bank

summary: 2020 closed above 14,000 (March low ~7,500). Record GST ₹1.15 lakh cr; strong auto sales (Tata Motors PV +84%). First-week-of-year direction theory (2011 example: −15% year). Risks: Georgia Senate runoffs, US jobs. PSU banks priced-for-bad argument (SBI/BoB). Range 13,800–14,200.

events.claim: India's December 2020 GST collections came at ₹1.15 lakh crore, then the highest ever (announced 1 Jan 2021)
Nifty closed calendar-2020 above 14,000 vs March 2020 low near 7,500; full-year 2020 return ~15%
US Georgia Senate runoffs on 5 Jan 2021 flagged as the key market risk for the first week
Tata Motors reported ~84% YoY growth in December 2020 passenger-vehicle sales

lessons: The first one or two weeks of January tend to set the year's tone (his empirical rule).
Negatives already in the price stop being negatives — PSU bank underperformance had priced in the bad news.
quote: If the first one or two weeks of the year are bullish, chances are very high the market stays bullish all year.
leaks: Possible reference to a Reliance penalty '₹500+ crore diluted to ₹30–40 crore' — unclear event, flag for verification

summary: MSCI deleted three Chinese telecom stocks Friday → Nifty +200 to ~14,350; FIIs bought >₹6,000 cr vs ~₹1,500 cr expected. Democrats sweep Georgia; Biden inauguration Jan 20; FM's '100-year budget' comment. Nifty-PE-28 correction myth challenged. IT results week ahead. Range 14,000–14,800, bullish.

events.claim: MSCI deleted three Chinese telecom stocks from indices (announced ~8–9 Jan 2021), sparking hopes of FII reallocation to India; Nifty rose ~200 points Friday to close ~14,350
FIIs bought more than ₹6,000 crore in Indian cash market on Friday 8 Jan 2021 versus an expected ~₹1,500 crore
Democrats won both Georgia Senate runoffs (5 Jan 2021), giving them Senate control; Biden inauguration set for 20 Jan 2021
TCS declared good Q3 results (weekend of 8–10 Jan 2021); Infosys and Wipro results due Wednesday, HCL Friday

lessons: A market that ignores a historically bearish valuation trigger (PE 28) is telling you this cycle is different — position with it, not against it.
Results-season trading rule: stocks that ran up before results get sold on good numbers; beaten-down ones short-cover.
quote: What you have seen so far is only a trailer — the main picture is still there.

summary: Turn to caution: Nifty future high 14,660, then second-wave Friday selling (−140); Infosys/HCL fell despite beats; US banks (WFC/JPM/C) fell on good results; VIX India & US >24; inauguration-week fear; sold weekly 13,500 PE @₹10. HDFC Bank weekend results. Range 14,000–14,700; sold 14,800–15,000 calls.

events.claim: Nifty futures hit 14,660 (then-record) before correcting; Friday 15 Jan closed ~140 points lower on second-wave selling
Infosys and HCL Tech reported beats but fell on result day; Wells Fargo, JPMorgan, Citigroup also fell on good US results (15 Jan 2021)
India VIX above 24 and CBOE VIX above 24 (15 Jan 2021) ahead of US inauguration; fears of repeat violence
HDFC Bank Q3 (weekend 16 Jan 2021): ~18% profit growth, ~15% NII growth despite RBI curbs on new digital products/credit cards

lessons: When good results can't lift stocks, the market is positioned too bullish — time for caution, not prediction.
Friday risk is three-nights risk: weekend mistakes cost triple.
quote: If you make a mistake Monday–Thursday you lose one night's sleep; on Friday you lose three.

summary: Nifty crossed 14,660→~14,780 then sold off; Bank Nifty −6% (−1,800) in two days. Reliance −2.5% just before results (profit booking rule); Bajaj Auto +10% on results. FIIs flipped sellers Friday after a buying month. OI: 14,000 PE ~₹30, 15,000 CE max. Budget (Feb 1) event risk. Range 14,000–14,800.

events.claim: Nifty crossed the prior record 14,660 and reached ~14,780, then Bank Nifty fell ~6% (~1,800 points) over two sessions
Reliance rose ~₹200 over two weeks then fell ~2.5% just before its Friday-evening Q3 results; its London GDR fell only ~1.5%
Bajaj Auto rose over 10% on strong results (22 Jan 2021), lifting the whole auto pack
Union Budget scheduled Monday 1 Feb 2021 — flagged as the dominant event risk for the coming week

lessons: Stocks that run up sharply just before results get profit-booked into the print; weak ones short-cover.
Budget reaction depends on positioning: pessimism ahead can mean a post-event rally; euphoria leaves no room for misses.
quote: Reliance's price does not move on results; it moves on re-rating.

summary: GameStop week: Nifty ~14,500 Monday open to sub-13,600 Friday (−900 in 4 sessions) amid the US short squeeze; short sellers reportedly lost $20–43bn. Budget tomorrow — historically ≤2% moves, GST weakened its power. ICICI/Shree Cement weekend results. OI 13,000 PE / 14,000 CE. Range 13,000–14,000.

events.claim: Week of 25–29 Jan 2021: Nifty fell from ~14,500 Monday open to below 13,600 Friday — a ~900-point crash in four sessions
GameStop short squeeze: conflicting reports that short sellers lost $20 billion and $43 billion
In the previous 10 years no budget-day Nifty move exceeded 2% — except Budget 2020, whose fall was COVID-driven, not budget-driven
ICICI Bank and Shree Cement declared strong results on Saturday 30 Jan 2021

lessons: Don't fear the event everyone watches; fear the one nobody is positioned for (short squeeze vs budget).
In a firm bull market, 10–20% corrections are normal; up to 30% is within bull-market norms.
quote: I am not worried about the budget; I am worried about the short squeeze in the US market.
leaks: "my team","my wife's account" — live-trading YouTube plan
NSE old-vs-new website OI explanation (shares vs lots)

summary: Budget-rally week: Bank Nifty +6,000+, Nifty +1,400; SBI 275→400 in ~6 sessions on results; FIIs re-flipped buyers. US stimulus: 50–50 Senate, VP Harris tie-break passed budget resolution (Feb 5); best US week since November. ~20% of Nifty50 results due. Support 14,500, resistance 15,500.

events.claim: Budget 2021 week: Bank Nifty rallied over 6,000 points and Nifty ~1,400 points; SBI went from 275 (Jan expiry) to ~400 in 5–6 sessions on strong results
US Senate passed the budget resolution 50–50 with VP Kamala Harris casting the tie-breaking vote (5 Feb 2021), advancing the $1.9tn stimulus
US markets posted their best weekly rally since November despite a mixed jobs report (5 Feb 2021), on stimulus hopes
His 4 Dec 2020 'make-or-break' call on the Georgia Senate seats played out: Democrats won both seats on 4–5 Jan with no market correction

lessons: A stable government is the most important precondition for a sustained bull market — policy-gridlock resolution is bullish regardless of party.
Good results move stocks violently; index impact follows later — trade the stocks, not the index, in results season.
quote: For any country to have a great bull market, the most important criterion is a stable government.

summary: Post-budget consolidation: Nifty pinned 15,000–15,250 (~250-pt range), Bank Nifty 35,500–36,600 with 700–800-point intraday swings; Friday afternoon Nifty −160 while Bank Nifty held; ICICI ATH +2.5%. CPI/IIP good. 14,000 PE ₹50→₹16. Strategy: sell puts on every 100-pt dip. Range 14,800–15,500.

events.claim: Post-budget week: Nifty held a ~250-point range (15,000–15,250) with 150–200-point intraday swings; Bank Nifty ranged 35,500–36,600
Friday 12 Feb 2021 post-close: India CPI and IIP data both came in good, pointing to economic revival
ICICI Bank hit a fresh all-time high (+2.5%) and cushioned Bank Nifty (~300-point upside vs Nifty) on 12 Feb 2021
14,000 PE (monthly) premium fell from ~₹50 to ~₹15–16 in a week — ~2% return on margin for put writers

lessons: The man-and-dog analogy: the economy is the man, the market the dog — the dog wanders but must travel with the man.
During consolidations, aggressive near-strike call writers become squeeze fuel for the next up-move.
quote: The man is the economy, the dog is the market — the dog may run ahead or behind, but must travel with the man.
leaks: Twitter trolling reference ('what happened to your 15k')

summary: Global rate-scare profit booking: two perspectives on rising yields (2003–07 Sensex 7× despite rate hikes; crude $10→$150). Friday bottomed 14,900; last hour +100/+400 with no institutional support (FII +₹100 cr). 15,000 straddle ₹260–270; March OI heavy 14,000 PE. Bearish only below 14,700. Range 14,800–15,500-ish.

events.claim: Rising US interest-rate/yield fears triggered global profit booking in the week to 19 Feb 2021
2003–2007 India bull run: Sensex rose from ~3,000 to 21,000 (~700%) while interest rates kept rising; crude rose from ~$10 to ~$150 in the same period
Friday 19 Feb 2021: Nifty bottomed at 14,900 and rallied ~100 points (Bank Nifty +400) in the last hour with almost no institutional buying (FII ~₹100 crore, DIIs selling)
15,000 straddle traded ~₹260–270; March-series 14,000 PE open interest more than double the 16,000 CE OI

lessons: Rising rates have two readings — demand-driven inflation is good for profits; but yields also pull money from equities. Hold both views.
Mid/small caps and PSUs holding up while large caps sell = selling is positioning, not distribution.
quote: Rising rates mean inflation; inflation means buying power; buying power means a good economy — or money leaving equities.
dup_flag: Feb–Mar 2021 correction whipsaw theme continues from 0258
leaks: "P. R. Sundar indicator" car-purchase joke (2008/2013/2015/2018 luxury-car buys)

summary: Friday 26 Feb crash: Nifty −700+ intraday, Bank Nifty −2,000+; FII net −₹8,300 cr despite ~₹5,000 cr MSCI rebalancing inflows (gross >₹13,000 cr, possibly record). VIX ~30. GDP +0.4% beat-ish; J&J vaccine + House-passed $1.9tn stimulus. His put-ratio (buy 14,600 PE / sell 2× 14,000 PE). 50-DMA 14,400–450 bottom zone.

events.claim: 26 Feb 2021: Nifty fell 700+ points intraday and Bank Nifty 2,000+; FIIs net sold ₹8,300 crore despite ~₹5,000 crore MSCI rebalancing inflows — gross selling >₹13,000 crore, possibly an all-time record day
India Q3 FY21 GDP released post-close 26 Feb 2021: +0.4% vs ~0.5% expected
US: Johnson & Johnson became the third authorized COVID vaccine and the House passed the $1.9 trillion stimulus (27 Feb 2021); Dow fell 400+ points Friday on yield fears
Tesla trading at ~1,200 P/E flagged as Nasdaq valuation risk

lessons: After a big crash the market needs hospital-rest before recovery — don't expect instant V-bounces.
OI is a guideline, not gospel — he faded the 14,000 PE support signal with a put ratio because his real risk line was 13,400.
High-VIX regimes are the option writer's harvest: far strikes still pay 4–5% a month.
quote: Once the market has fallen so much, it cannot recover immediately — it must rest in hospital for a while.
leaks: Brokerage-referral drive: 'more than 2,000 inquiries to find a good broker' (franchisee business)

summary: Whipsaw recap: Feb-expiry 15,100 → sub-14,500 in one session → 15,300 rebound → two gap-down days. Strong US payrolls (Dow +600 late); China Jan–Feb exports +60.6%/imports +22.2% beat. FII −₹2,000 cr/DII −₹1,000 cr; FIIs bought ₹13,000 cr options (2/3 puts). 15,000 CE +1.5M OI = squeeze fuel. SEBI margin rules thinning sellers. Range 14,500–15,500.

events.claim: US February payrolls (5 Mar 2021) came in excellent; Dow rallied 600+ points late Friday; SGX Nifty ~+100
China Jan–Feb 2021 exports rose ~60.6% YoY (vs ~40% expected) and imports ~22.2% (vs ~15% expected)
FIIs sold ₹2,000 crore cash and DIIs ₹1,000 crore on Friday 5 Mar 2021; FIIs had bought ~₹13,000 crore of options Thursday, two-thirds of it puts
15,000 CE added ~1.5 million shares of open interest Friday — aggressive call writing set up short-covering fuel; the 15,000 max-OI signal had already failed once in the same conditions

lessons: Max-OI signals fail in high-volatility regimes — heavy call writing into strength becomes upside fuel.
Post-SEBI-margin-rules scarcity of sellers keeps far-OTM premiums artificially rich — a structural edge for sellers.
quote: In these situations, highest open interest does not work.

summary: Recorded on holiday in the hills: Friday 12 Mar saw a 250-pt gap-up fail at ~1:30pm institutional selling — Nifty −500 from high (~14,950 low), Bank Nifty −1,000; closed ~15,000 = Feb-expiry close. Whipsaw month: 15,000 straddle ₹800→₹600 (₹200). FII <₹1,000 cr. Upside cap 15,500. Range 14,500–15,500.

events.claim: Friday 12 Mar 2021: after a 250-point gap-up (Thursday was Shivaratri holiday), institutional selling from ~1:30pm drove Nifty ~500 points off the high (low ~14,950) and Bank Nifty ~1,000; close ~15,000
March had gone nowhere close-to-close: February expiry closed 15,100 and two weeks later Nifty was ~15,100 again despite violent moves
15,000 short straddle opened the series ~₹800 and was ~₹600 by 12 March (~₹200 profit) despite the volatility
FII cash selling that Friday was under ₹1,000 crore vs ₹8,000+ crore on the earlier crash Friday — the fall was positioning-driven (stop-losses), not institutional

lessons: In a whipsaw month, the short straddle earns without predicting — volatility premium is the trade.
Gap-ups near all-time highs into thin liquidity are fade candidates; 1:30pm is the institutional session's turn.
quote: No need to tell who makes the best money without much risk — the short straddle.

summary: Archegos block-sale scare ($20bn+ via Morgan Stanley/Goldman, China-tech/US-media names −25%) vs Ever Given refloat lifting sentiment; SGX whipsaw on holiday liquidity. India VIX −10% Friday; Bank Nifty futures at unprecedented ~400-pt premium. Semiconductor shortage crushed autos (Maruti <7,000). Support ~14,200. Range 14,200–15,000.

events.claim: Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs together sold over $20 billion of stock (mostly China tech and US media) on 26 Mar 2021 after margin calls on a Hong Kong-linked family office (Archegos); several stocks fell 25%+
The Ever Given was refloated after six days blocking the Suez Canal (29 Mar 2021), lifting oil/shipping sentiment
India VIX fell ~10% on Friday 26 Mar 2021; Bank Nifty futures traded a ~400-point premium to spot — unprecedented vs a normal ~200 max
Semiconductor shortage: Maruti fell from ~8,300 to below 7,000 and Hero MotoCorp from ~3,500 to below 3,000 over months

lessons: Semiconductor shortage was a months-long auto headwind — supply-chain constraints trump demand data.
Holiday liquidity makes SGX signals noisy — thin-market moves shouldn't be trusted.
Politics and markets: take positions on business logic only.
quote: We are in the stock market to make money — politics is not our business.
leaks: Political-denial passage + 'counselor in DMK' insinuations + politician-corruption joke (drop per policy)
'I recommended Sun TV… politically oriented to DMK' (political stock call — genericize or drop)

summary: Recovery week (3 sessions): Nifty regained ~14,900 after 14,260 low; S&P 500 crossed 4,000 first time; US payrolls +916k (7-month high). Feb–Mar correction measured −1,200 (15,450→14,260), two-thirds recovered; next magnet 15,450. RBI policy Wed (status quo expected). India VIX below 20 (2nd time in 2021). Range 14,500–15,200.

events.claim: S&P 500 crossed 4,000 for the first time on 1 Apr 2021
US March payrolls (2 Apr 2021): +916,000 jobs, a seven-month high, well above expectations
The Feb–Mar correction ran 15,450 → 14,260 (~1,200 points, his largest ever seen) and recovered ~two-thirds by 1 Apr
India VIX closed below 20 on 1 Apr 2021 — only the second such close of 2021 — signalling smaller near-term moves

lessons: Fibonacci-style retracement logic: after two-thirds recovery, the prior high is the next magnet.
His max correction observed in a bull market: ~1,200 points — useful as a stress ruler, not a rule.
quote: Bull-market corrections are fast and furious — the maximum correction I have seen is 1,200 points.

summary: Local-vs-global tug-of-war: US at ATH while Maharashtra weighs a 15-day lockdown (second wave); Apr 5 Monday −400 on weekend restrictions. IT results week (TCS Mon, Infosys Wed holiday, Wipro/Mindtree; HDFC Bank Sat). Calls written > puts (15,000 CE wall). Both institutions sold Friday. Range 14,500–15,000.

events.claim: News reports on 11 Apr 2021 said the Maharashtra government may announce a 15-day complete lockdown amid the second COVID wave
Monday 5 Apr 2021: Nifty fell 400+ points intraday (~200 recovered) after Maharashtra weekend restrictions
Week of 12 Apr: TCS results Monday after hours; 14 Apr a trading holiday; Infosys impact thus on Thursday; HDFC Bank results Saturday 17 Apr
Both FIIs and DIIs sold cash on Friday 9 Apr 2021

lessons: When global and local forces conflict, the market whipsaws — trade the ranges, not the narratives.
Heavy call writing below price marks short-term bearish positioning even when the trend is up.
quote: We are caught between positive global cues and negative local cues.

summary: Third straight 'Monday mayhem' (Apr 12 −500+, cases >2 lakh, Maharashtra ~60–70k/day peak). OI turning bullish: 14,900 CE unwound (monthly); March precedent — 14,000 PE went to zero by expiry. FIIs back to buying; retail dominating like GameStop. HDFC Bank results slightly light. Truncated week (Ram Navami). Range 14,200–15,000.

events.claim: Monday 12 Apr 2021: Nifty fell 500+ points intraday as India's daily cases crossed 200,000 (Maharashtra ~60–70k/day) — third consecutive Monday with a 400+ point intraday fall
14,900 CE (29 Apr monthly) saw heavy open-interest unwinding; weekly puts written at near strikes vs far calls — OI leaning bullish despite COVID fear
March precedent: the 14,000 PE carried heavy OI all month and went to zero by expiry — he expects the same for April
HDFC Bank Q4 results (17 Apr 2021) slightly below market expectation; TCS had fallen ~5% the day after good results then recovered

lessons: Result-day reaction follows positioning, not the print — shorts into a bad number can fuel a +25% rip (BoB precedent).
One-third Bank Nifty weight: HDFC Bank's reaction moves both indices.
quote: Market positioning decides the result-day move, not the result itself.
leaks: Personal 15,000 short straddle Dec series: 20% in 20 sessions (genericize)
'watch my Dalal Street Week ahead' self-reference
Bank of Baroda worst-loss→+25% anecdote (verify before use)

summary: Four weeks of violent chop, net zero: March series closed 14,325, now ~14,340. India at record 3.5 lakh daily cases; Japan emergency in 4 cities. FIIs −₹4,000 cr over 4 sessions but DIIs absorb (MF inflows resumed); Bank Nifty finally outperformed. ICICI good-but-light results; RIL Friday. Expiry-week volatility. Supports 14,200/14,000. Range 14,000–14,800.

events.claim: India's daily COVID cases hit a record ~350,000 around 25 Apr 2021; Japan declared a state of emergency in four major cities (23 Apr 2021)
ICICI Bank Q4 (24 Apr 2021): good but slightly below market expectation
FIIs sold over ₹4,000 crore across the last four sessions; DIIs bought more than FIIs sold daily, helped by the first net MF inflow in months
Four weeks of extreme volatility left the market net unchanged: March series closed 14,325; latest close ~14,340

lessons: When DIIs consistently out-absorb FII selling, breakdowns fail — watch the absorption, not the headline flows.
Results calendar dominates expiry weeks: plan around RIL/HUL/Axis prints rather than index levels.
quote: For four weeks the market has gone nowhere — but the ride has been violent.

summary: Election-day special: TMC landslide in West Bengal against exit polls; DMK leading TN. US barred Indian travellers from May 4; FII −₹3,500 cr Friday after rally to 15,050. April GST ₹1.41 lakh cr all-time record (+20% MoM) despite COVID. Sputnik V landed; 18–45 vaccination opened. Calls > puts now (14,800/15,000 walls). Range ~14,200–15,000.

events.claim: 2 May 2021 state results: TMC won a landslide in West Bengal contrary to most exit polls; DMK front led in Tamil Nadu
US restricted travel from India effective 4 May 2021 (announced 30 Apr); FIIs sold ~₹3,500 crore on Friday 30 Apr after a rally to 15,050
April 2021 GST collections hit an all-time record ~₹1.41 lakh crore, ~20% above March's ~₹1.20 lakh crore, despite peak COVID
Russia's Sputnik V first consignment arrived in India (1 May 2021) and vaccination opened for the 18–45 age group, with states flagging supply shortfalls

lessons: A record tax collection during the worst health month is the economy's tell — separate the health cycle from the economy.
Sentiment flip visible in OI: unwinding 14,900/15,000 puts + adding 14,800–15,000 calls = resistance building into strength.
quote: Such a bad month, yet the highest GST collection ever — the economy is doing better than the fear.
leaks: 5paisa.com sponsorship + brokerage-plan promo ('link in the description')
Political content: WB/TN result commentary, Sun TV–DMK framing, 'Sun rising… SON rising' joke

summary: US April payrolls +266k vs ~1M expected → 'very bad news is good news' rally (rate-hike odds down); SGX +120. India >4 lakh daily cases all week; TN 14-day lockdown from May 10. India VIX −10% in a week despite the record wave. OI: 14,500 PE max, 15,200 CE max. Range shift to 14,500–15,200; caution above 15,000.

events.claim: US April payrolls (7 May 2021): +266,000 vs ~1,000,000 expected; unemployment ticked up — yet US markets rallied strongly on reduced rate-hike odds
India reported 400,000+ daily COVID cases throughout the week (record second wave); Tamil Nadu announced a 14-day lockdown from 10 May 2021
India VIX fell ~10% over the week despite record daily cases — the market pricing a near-term peak
Thursday 13 May a trading holiday (Ramzan); CPI and IIP due Wednesday post-close; results: Asian Paints, Lupin, Dr Reddy, Cipla, L&T

lessons: Good news is good news; very good news is bad news; bad news is bad news; very bad news is good news — position by what the news does to policy expectations, not to the economy.
VIX falling into a catastrophe is a market-bottom signal: fear is peaking even as cases peak.
quote: The crying baby only gets the chocolate.
